text: The Quiet Room got me through a long night shift. Thank you for the Minnie Riperton.
name: Nova Test
reply: Nova, a long night shift is exactly when you need something like Minnie Riperton. That voice doesn't fill a room so much as it holds you inside it. I'm glad The Quiet Room did what it was supposed to do. That's the whole point of it, really. You take care of yourself.
